<!-- Paper 1: AI Wiki Companion -->
<div class="paper-card conference-paper" data-year="2026" data-topic="ai-education">
<div class="paper-badge">Conference Paper</div>
<div class="paper-content">
<h3 class="paper-title">
<a href="ai-wiki-companion-2026.html">From Notes to Knowledge: Designing an AI Wiki Companion for Learner-in-the-Loop Knowledge Construction</a>
</h3>
<div class="paper-meta">
<span class="paper-authors">Research Team, AI Education Research</span>
<span class="paper-venue">LAK/AIED 2027 Submission</span>
<span class="paper-date">September 2026</span>
</div>
<p class="paper-abstract">
Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) has substantially reduced the effort required to produce summaries, explanations, structured notes, and other learning artefacts. Although these tools lower the barrier to producing polished outputs, they may also reduce the depth of cognitive engagement required for genuine knowledge construction. This paper presents the design and formative evaluation of an AI Wiki Companion that positions GenAI as a metacognitive scaffold rather than a substitute knowledge producer.
</p>
<div class="paper-tags">
<span class="tag">knowledge construction</span>
<span class="tag">self-regulated learning</span>
<span class="tag">metacognitive scaffolding</span>
<span class="tag">generative AI</span>
</div>
<div class="paper-actions">
<a href="ai-wiki-companion-2026.html" class="btn btn-primary">View Paper</a>
<a href="#" class="btn btn-outline">Download PDF</a>
</div>
</div>
</div>
